tagline: OUTSOURCED CFO SERVICES  ·  NONPROFIT CLIENTS  ·  CAPITAL PLANNING  ·  BOARD ADVISORY
profile: Advisory CFO who leads finance for multiple nonprofit and mission-driven clients at once. Through Maroon Strategist, provides FP&A, budgeting, treasury, cash-flow forecasting, audit readiness, internal controls, and fund accounting for organizations across nonprofit, private, education, and public-sector settings. Executes turnarounds and audit remediation, recovered $1.5M+ in client tax savings, and structures funding and capital strategy through scenario modeling. Previously held P&L accountability for an $8M portfolio within a $50M+ nonprofit, reversing a $1M deficit into a 13% surplus. Builds lasting client relationships and represents organizations at public forums.

bullets.text: Lead financial planning, budgeting, treasury, liquidity management, and cash-flow forecasting for client organizations across nonprofit, private, education, and public-sector settings.
Execute financial turnarounds, forensic accounting, historical clean-up, and audit remediation for organizations with reporting deficiencies.
Identified and recovered $1.5M+ in tax savings through detailed financial analysis and correction of reporting deficiencies.
Spearhead liquidity and working-capital strategy, including covenant monitoring, short-term financing analysis, and stress testing; support capital allocation through scenario modeling.
Direct audit readiness and external audit processes; ensure GAAP and Uniform Guidance compliance; design internal controls and fund-accounting frameworks.
Structured the financial framework for a NYPA Clean Energy Workforce Program, aligning public funding, compliance, and performance metrics.
